scope: Apply bounded cursor pagination in EcocreditService list handlers

contract.cursor: ASCII decimal row-offset bytes; clients pass next_key back unchanged as offset
contract.invalid_request: Malformed/out-of-range cursors and limits over 500 return INVALID_ARGUMENT before service DB acquisition
contract.legacy_calls: Requests without the pagination message retain their current response shape

verification.pagination_and_enabled_transport: 16 passed; includes two-page loopback round trip and invalid-input preflight

data_access.loopback: Ephemeral localhost transport with synthetic rows and mocked DB factory

limitations: Handlers currently materialize their existing manager result lists before slicing, so response size is bounded but database read volume and peak list memory are not.
Each page reads a fresh result set; concurrent inserts or deletes can shift offset pages.
Authentication/tenant policy parity, TLS, and REST parity remain open; MAN-CAP-064 is not accepted.
